reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI skin that changes scoped visual styling, backgrounds, contrast handling, and focus mode while leaving sessions, models, tools, and backend services unchanged.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供黑鲸实验室视觉主题、背景、对比度保护和专注模式。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web client theme that provides Black Whale Lab visuals, background artwork, contrast protection, and a focus mode.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness Web client presentation layer
Applies scoped theme variables and background artwork
Provides a focus mode and contrast adjustments
Loads as a DeepSeek Harness profile plugin
